principle: Use the same knowledge graph and change projection based on relation type.
restriction: Do not allow automatic layout to determine conceptual hierarchy. Use curated semantic coordinates for canonical atlas views.

views.title: There Is No More Outside

primary.implementation: hierarchy + partition with rounded nested rectangles

views.dataShape: rooted containment hierarchy plus typed cross-boundary transfer edges
views.why: Nested rectangles make the no-floor claim literal: each apparent outside is visibly inside a larger enclosure. A transfer path shows that consequence crosses rather than vanishes.
avoid: force-directed graph as the first view
geographic map unless the example is explicitly spatial
views.mobileFallback: Vertical nested cards with a stepwise burden trace.
views.reducedMotionFallback: Static before/after states with the receiving box highlighted.

accessibility.textTemplate: The burden leaves {source} and enters {receiver}; both are contained within {largerSystem}.

views.title: Externality Is a Boundary Choice

secondary.implementation: filter nodes by accounting inclusion state

views.dataShape: directed weighted flows from activity to benefits and burdens, each tagged represented/unrepresented
views.why: A Sankey diagram shows that reducing a represented cost does not erase flow; it redirects burden into another node.
views.mobileFallback: Ordered source → decision boundary → receiver flow list with quantities or qualitative severity.
views.reducedMotionFallback: Side-by-side inclusive and exclusive accounting states.

accessibility.textTemplate: {activity} produces {benefit} for {beneficiary} and transfers {burden} to {receiver}; the current accounting {includesOrExcludes} that burden.

views.title: Business Is Already Artificial Agency

primary.implementation: fixed functional sectors around a central institutional identity

secondary.implementation: typed arrows for sense, decide, act, receive feedback

views.dataShape: typed heterogeneous graph with functional roles and directed agency edges
views.why: A constrained network reveals that the business is neither one person nor an inert container; it is a persistent loop composed of human, legal, financial, and computational parts.
avoid: anthropomorphic face or brain metaphor as the primary view
unconstrained force layout that scrambles functional roles
equating business and AI in every property
views.mobileFallback: Six-stage agent loop with expandable component lists.

accessibility.textTemplate: The organization senses through {sensors}, remembers through {memory}, decides through {policy}, acts through {actuators}, and persists through {persistenceMechanisms}.

views.title: AI Accelerates Institutional Agency

primary.implementation: stable node positions with edge throughput and latency controls

secondary.implementation: optional animated tokens along decision edges

views.dataShape: agent graph plus latency, throughput, review gate, and interruptibility attributes
views.why: Keeping the same graph while changing rate makes the thesis legible: the category of agent remains, but the cadence and bypass risk change.
avoid: speed presented as intelligence or legitimacy
views.mobileFallback: Before/after agency loop with latency and removed-gate badges.

accessibility.textTemplate: At {rate}, the system completes {actions}; the following review gates are preserved: {preserved}; the following are bypassed: {bypassed}.

views.title: Abstraction Without Return

primary.implementation: central root with ten severance branches and consequence leaves

views.dataShape: rooted doctrine tree with cross-links from each root to repair routes
views.why: A radial root structure makes the shared origin visible while preserving distinct branches. It supports card expansion without pretending the roots are identical.
avoid: ten equal cards with no shared structure
views.mobileFallback: Accordion root cards grouped by severance type.

accessibility.textTemplate: {root} separates {leftTerm} from {rightTerm}, producing {consequences}; its repair is {repair}.

views.title: Accounting Meets Software Engineering

primary.implementation: layered directed graph with normal, exceptional, recovery, and escalation branches

secondary.implementation: solid normal flow, dashed failure flow, return repair flow

views.dataShape: directed state-transition graph with path kind, owner, witness, and closure status
views.why: A layered DAG shows the exact professional move: a thin normative path becomes a richer executable state space with explicit failure and repair.
avoid: treating all social values as software types
views.mobileFallback: Stepwise state machine with expandable exception and repair branches.

accessibility.textTemplate: The normal path moves from {start} to {success}. Failure {failure} is detected by {witness}, owned by {owner}, and repaired through {repairPath}.

views.title: Boundary First

primary.implementation: arc segments plus directed radial links

secondary.implementation: one stage activated at a time; user controlled

views.dataShape: ordered cyclic states with success, defect, repair, and promotion branches
views.why: The radial cycle communicates recurrence and repair while direct stage selection supports operational learning.
avoid: introducing the full formal vocabulary at once
views.mobileFallback: Vertical cycle with return arrows and a sticky current-stage card.
views.reducedMotionFallback: Static cycle with selection highlighting only.

accessibility.textTemplate: At {stage}, the system {action}. If {condition}, it proceeds to {successNext}; otherwise it exposes {defect} and returns through {repairNext}.

views.title: Every Baseline Opens a Field of Variation

primary.implementation: levels of stable organization along an ordered axis

secondary.implementation: collapse, restore, and promote branches at each level

views.dataShape: ordered multilevel hierarchy with baseline dependencies and outcome branches
views.why: The combined hierarchy and ordered progression shows that a new level becomes a substrate without ceasing to depend on the levels beneath it.
avoid: literal universal history claim with unsupported precision
single upward arrow implying guaranteed progress
collapsing particles, matter, cells, and institutions into identical mechanisms
views.mobileFallback: Stacked baseline ladder with expandable dependency and failure panels.
views.reducedMotionFallback: Static ladder and three outcome branches.

accessibility.textTemplate: {level} depends on {substrate}; variation can {restore}, {collapse}, or {promote} into {successor}.

views.title: Representational Evolution

primary.implementation: successive representation cycles positioned on expanding radius

secondary.implementation: branch rejected, repaired, and promoted revisions

views.dataShape: ordered representation versions with defect evidence, tests, and promotion status
views.why: A spiral preserves recurrence while showing that successful repair changes the baseline rather than returning to the identical starting point.
avoid: simple loop that implies no learning
views.mobileFallback: Version timeline with defect → revision → test → promotion cards.
views.reducedMotionFallback: Static stepped spiral or numbered timeline.

accessibility.textTemplate: Version {version} encountered {defect}; revision {revision} preserved {invariant}, passed {tests}, and received status {status}.

views.title: Civilizational Mechanics

primary.implementation: nested civilization layers: embodied life, households, organizations, institutions, infrastructures, biosphere

secondary.implementation: fixed anchor positions with force used only for collision and local adjustment

views.dataShape: containment hierarchy plus typed execution, consequence, evidence, and repair edges
views.why: Nested layers show substrate dependence; cross-layer edges show that laws, accounts, software, and organizations execute across boundaries rather than staying inside one level.
avoid: implying civilization can be engineered as one monolithic machine
views.mobileFallback: Layered vertical stack with selectable execution chains.
views.reducedMotionFallback: Static nested layers with one highlighted chain at a time.

accessibility.textTemplate: {representation} is executed by {agent} through {mechanism}, affecting {system}; consequence is witnessed by {witness} and repaired through {repair}.

views.title: Route the Defect to Consequence Closure

primary.implementation: roots on left, consequence classes in center, repair routes on right

secondary.implementation: stroke and pattern rather than color alone

views.dataShape: typed weighted tripartite graph: root → consequence → repair route
views.why: The Sankey view makes many-to-many routing visible: one root can produce several consequences, and one repair route can address several roots without collapsing their distinctions.
avoid: ranking harms on a single scalar
views.mobileFallback: Wizard: diagnose root → select consequence → construct repair packet.
views.reducedMotionFallback: Static highlighted path through the router.

accessibility.textTemplate: The diagnosed root {root} produces {consequence}. Recommended route {route} requires owner {owner}, witness {witness}, and closure test {test}.

views.title: Keep the Future Open

primary.layout: curated semantic coordinates with collision simulation
primary.implementation: manual cluster anchors; force only preserves spacing and drag behavior

secondary.implementation: zoom from completed pathway neighborhood to full atlas

views.dataShape: typed content graph plus pathway emphasis and journey-state overlays
views.why: The same nodes remain in place while context expands, preserving spatial memory and proving that the sequence and atlas are projections of one graph.
avoid: equal node size implying equal authority
removing the learner’s selected path on reveal
views.mobileFallback: Searchable clustered list with a focused neighborhood view and pathway emphasis.
views.reducedMotionFallback: Crossfade from pathway neighborhood to full atlas with stable node positions.

accessibility.textTemplate: The atlas contains {nodeCount} typed concepts. Your completed path emphasizes {path}; the recommended next regions are {regions}.
